blocks.zh: 供應商、使用者需求規格、設施設計與廢棄物管理
blocks.en: Suppliers, User Requirements Specification, Facility Design and Waste Management

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解供應商品質協議 (Quality Agreement) 的核心要素，以及如何透過稽核制度確保整個供應鏈的品質一致性
blocks.en: Understand the core elements of a Quality Agreement and how an audit program keeps quality consistent across the whole supply chain

blocks.zh: 掌握供應商稽核 (Supplier Audit) 的規劃原則——稽核頻率如何基於風險與供應商關係決定，以及稽核清單的關鍵項目
blocks.en: Master the planning principles of a Supplier Audit: how audit frequency is set based on risk and the supplier relationship, and the key items on an audit checklist

blocks.zh: 了解使用者需求規格 (URS) 的架構與撰寫方法，包括品質要求、製程要求、與供應商溝通的策略
blocks.en: Understand the structure and drafting of a User Requirements Specification (URS), including quality requirements, process requirements and how to communicate with suppliers

blocks.zh: 熟悉 SUT 設施設計的三大概念——舞池式 (Dance Floor)、箱中工廠 (Factory-in-a-Box)、箱中箱 (Box-within-a-Box)——以及各概念的適用時機與挑戰
blocks.en: Become familiar with the three SUT facility design concepts (Dance Floor, Factory-in-a-Box, Box-within-a-Box), and when each applies and what challenges it brings

blocks.zh: 理解 SUT 廢棄物管理的兩大路徑——高壓蒸汽滅菌去污 (Autoclave Decontamination) 與焚化 (Incineration)——以及何時需要哪種處理方式
blocks.en: Understand the two main routes for SUT waste management (Autoclave Decontamination and Incineration) and when each is needed

blocks.zh: 建立從「供應商選擇 → URS 制定 → 設施設計 → 廢棄物處理」的完整 SUT 實施思維鏈
blocks.en: Build the complete chain of thinking for SUT implementation: supplier selection → URS development → facility design → waste handling

blocks.zh: 2.5 Supplier Quality and Audits（供應商品質與稽核）
blocks.en: 2.5 Supplier Quality and Audits

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUT 供應商關係的特殊性
blocks.en: Core Concept: What Makes SUT Supplier Relationships Special

blocks.zh: SUT 的供應鏈不像傳統的化學原料採購——供應商不只是「賣材料的」，他們的製造環境品質直接影響你的藥品品質。
blocks.en: The SUT supply chain is unlike conventional chemical raw material purchasing. A supplier is not just "selling material"; the quality of their manufacturing environment directly affects the quality of your drug product.

blocks.zh: 這裡有個重要的邏輯鏈：
blocks.en: There is an important chain of logic here:

blocks.zh: 供應商的潔淨室環境 → 影響一次性組件的微粒污染
blocks.en: The supplier's cleanroom environment → affects particulate contamination of single-use components

blocks.zh: 供應商的滅菌驗證 → 決定你的產品無菌保證水平
blocks.en: The supplier's sterilization validation → determines the sterility assurance level of your product

blocks.zh: 供應商的原材料管理 → 影響 E&L 萃取物/滲出物結果
blocks.en: The supplier's raw material control → affects your E&L (extractables/leachables) results

blocks.zh: 因此，對 SUT 供應商的品質管理，需要比傳統包材供應商更深入的技術介入，這就是 technical diligence（技術盡職調查） 的意涵。
blocks.en: Quality management of SUT suppliers therefore requires deeper technical involvement than for conventional packaging suppliers. This is what technical diligence means.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 選擇 SUT 供應商就像選擇外科手術器械廠商——你不只是買一個產品，而是在建立一個影響患者安全的合作關係。一旦使用了某個品牌的一次性生物反應器袋，你就很難中途換廠商（因為需要重新做 E&L、確效等）。所以在選擇之前，要像選擇長期合作夥伴一樣認真評估。
blocks.en: Choosing a SUT supplier is like choosing a surgical instrument manufacturer: you are not just buying a product, you are building a relationship that affects patient safety. Once you use one brand of single-use bioreactor bag, it is hard to switch suppliers midway (because E&L, validation and so on must be repeated). So evaluate the choice as seriously as you would a long-term partner.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用情境
blocks.en: CDMO Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 無菌充填廠，你同時服務多個客戶，每個客戶可能指定不同的 SUT 供應商。你需要建立一個核准供應商清單 (Approved Supplier List, ASL)，並維護每個供應商的稽核記錄、品質協議和技術變更通知歷史。這項管理工作的複雜度遠超過傳統不銹鋼系統時代。
blocks.en: At a sterile fill-finish CDMO you serve several clients at once, and each may specify a different SUT supplier. You need to build an Approved Supplier List (ASL) and maintain for each supplier its audit records, quality agreement and history of technical change notifications. The complexity of this work far exceeds that of the stainless steel era.

blocks.zh: 2.5.1 Establishing Supplier Quality Requirements（建立供應商品質要求）
blocks.en: 2.5.1 Establishing Supplier Quality Requirements

blocks.zh: 核心概念：品質協議 vs. 供應協議
blocks.en: Core Concept: Quality Agreement vs. Supply Agreement

blocks.zh: 品質協議 (Quality Agreement) 聚焦「誰對什麼負責」——GMP 責任分配、稽核權利、變更通知義務。
blocks.en: A Quality Agreement focuses on "who is responsible for what": allocation of GMP responsibilities, audit rights and change notification obligations.

blocks.zh: 供應協議 (Supply Agreement) 聚焦「商業條件」——價格、交期、付款條件。
blocks.en: A Supply Agreement focuses on "commercial terms": price, delivery time and payment terms.

blocks.zh: 技術協議 (Technical Agreement) 聚焦「產品規格」——設計參數、測試方法。
blocks.en: A Technical Agreement focuses on "product specifications": design parameters and test methods.

blocks.zh: ISPE 建議三者分開——因為品質協議需要由 QA 部門主導，不應受到採購談判的商業壓力影響。在實務中，許多公司會在同一份文件中混入這三類條款，這會導致 QA 在關鍵時刻失去主導權。
blocks.en: ISPE recommends keeping the three separate, because the quality agreement should be led by QA and should not be subject to the commercial pressure of purchasing negotiations. In practice, many companies mix all three types of clauses into one document, which leaves QA without control at critical moments.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「稽核權利」條款的重要性
blocks.en: Key Point: The Importance of the "Audit Rights" Clause

blocks.zh: 品質協議中最容易被忽略、但最有用的條款之一是：「端用戶有權對供應商進行定期及有因稽核」。
blocks.en: One of the most overlooked yet most useful clauses in a quality agreement is: "the end user has the right to conduct routine and for-cause audits of the supplier."

blocks.zh: 如果這個條款不在簽約前明確寫入，供應商日後可以拒絕你的稽核要求。在 SUT 供應商出現品質事件時（例如某批次一次性袋子的滅菌記錄有疑問），這個條款就是你進入供應商現場調查的法律依據。
blocks.en: If this clause is not written in explicitly before signing, the supplier can later refuse your audit request. When a SUT supplier has a quality event (for example, doubts about the sterilization records of a batch of single-use bags), this clause is your legal basis for entering the supplier's site to investigate.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：供應商的「工廠語言」
blocks.en: Analogy: The Supplier's "Factory Language"

blocks.zh: ISPE 要求供應商的製造操作要與端用戶的操作「對齊」，就像你聘請外包廠商要說同一種語言。一個好的 SUT 供應商不只是「把東西生產出來」，他們應該理解為什麼需要潔淨室環境分類、為什麼需要可追溯性、為什麼變更通知很重要——因為他們了解下游客戶面對的 GMP 合規壓力。
blocks.en: ISPE expects the supplier's manufacturing operations to be "aligned" with the end user's, just as you would want an outsourced contractor to speak the same language. A good SUT supplier does not just "make the product"; they should understand why cleanroom classification is needed, why traceability is needed and why change notification matters, because they understand the GMP compliance pressure their downstream customers face.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：QbD 在 SUT 供應商端的應用
blocks.en: Core Concept: Applying QbD at the SUT Supplier

blocks.zh: 品質源於設計 (Quality by Design, QbD)：這個藥品開發的概念同樣適用於 SUT 供應商。好的供應商不是「生產完再測試」，而是：
blocks.en: Quality by Design (QbD): this drug development concept applies equally to SUT suppliers. A good supplier does not "produce first and test afterwards" but instead:

blocks.zh: 定義原材料設計空間（哪些聚合物特性是關鍵的）
blocks.en: Defines the raw material design space (which polymer properties are critical)

blocks.zh: 設定製程設計空間（成型、焊接的條件範圍）
blocks.en: Sets the process design space (the condition ranges for molding and welding)

blocks.zh: 實施製程內管制（in-process control），而不是依賴最終測試
blocks.en: Implements in-process control rather than relying on final testing

blocks.zh: 這樣才能真正降低批次間的品質變異——這對 E&L 一致性尤其重要。
blocks.en: Only this truly reduces batch-to-batch quality variation, which is especially important for E&L consistency.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的採購流程中，要求供應商提供標準化產品編碼體系非常實用——它讓你的 ERP 系統可以精確追蹤「哪個批次的產品用了哪個供應商的哪個型號組件」，這在調查投訴或召回時是不可或缺的可追溯性基礎。
blocks.en: In CDMO purchasing, it is very practical to require the supplier to provide a standardized product coding system. It lets your ERP system track exactly "which batch of product used which model of component from which supplier", an indispensable basis for traceability when investigating complaints or recalls.

blocks.zh: 2.5.1.3 Supplier Capability Matrix（供應商能力矩陣）
blocks.en: 2.5.1.3 Supplier Capability Matrix

blocks.zh: 核心概念：兩種矩陣的用途差異
blocks.en: Core Concept: Different Purposes of the Two Matrices

blocks.zh: 基本矩陣（Must-Have）：先過濾掉不符合資格的供應商——這是一個「通過/不通過」的門檻測試。例如：如果供應商沒有潔淨室監測程序，直接淘汰，不需要進一步評估。
blocks.en: Basic matrix (Must-Have): first filters out unqualified suppliers. This is a pass/fail threshold test. For example, if a supplier has no cleanroom monitoring program, eliminate them directly without further evaluation.

blocks.zh: 加權矩陣：在通過基本門檻的供應商中，比較誰「更好」。每項能力根據你的業務需求給予不同的重要性分數（1-10分），最後計算加權總分來排序。
blocks.en: Weighted matrix: among suppliers that pass the basic threshold, compare who is "better". Each capability is given an importance score (1-10) according to your business needs, and the weighted total is calculated for ranking.

blocks.zh: 這個雙層篩選方法確保你既不會接受資格不足的供應商，也能在合格供應商中做出最優選擇。
blocks.en: This two-tier screening method ensures that you neither accept an under-qualified supplier nor miss the best choice among qualified ones.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在你的工廠中，如果要選擇一次性生物反應器袋的供應商，哪三項能力是你的「絕對必備 (must-have)」？為什麼？
blocks.en: At your site, if you were selecting a supplier of single-use bioreactor bags, which three capabilities would be your absolute must-haves? Why?

blocks.zh: 加權矩陣中，「照射方法 (Irradiation methods)」和「變更管控 (Change control)」哪個在你的業務中更重要？這個優先順序如何影響你的供應商選擇？
blocks.en: In the weighted matrix, which is more important to your business: "Irradiation methods" or "Change control"? How would this priority affect your supplier selection?

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境下服務多個客戶，供應商能力矩陣可以成為客戶展示材料的一部分：「我們用什麼標準評估和選擇 SUT 供應商」。這不只是內部採購工具，更是向客戶展示供應鏈管理嚴謹性的證據。
blocks.en: In a CDMO serving multiple clients, the supplier capability matrix can become part of your client presentation material: "the criteria we use to evaluate and select SUT suppliers". It is not only an internal purchasing tool but also evidence of the rigor of your supply chain management.

blocks.zh: 2.5.2 Practices Applied to Meet Supplier Quality Requirements（達到供應商品質要求的實務做法）
blocks.en: 2.5.2 Practices Applied to Meet Supplier Quality Requirements

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUT 供應商的潔淨室等級要求
blocks.en: Core Concept: Cleanroom Grade Requirements for SUT Suppliers

blocks.zh: ISPE SUT 對供應商製造環境的要求是：
blocks.en: ISPE SUT sets the following requirements for the supplier's manufacturing environment:

blocks.zh: 一般組件與組合件製造：ISO 8 / EU Grade C（操作中）
blocks.en: General component and assembly manufacture: ISO 8 / EU Grade C (in operation)

blocks.zh: 最終組合作業：ISO 7 / EU Grade B（操作中）
blocks.en: Final assembly operations: ISO 7 / EU Grade B (in operation)

blocks.zh: 這個要求的背後邏輯是：SUT 組件要直接接觸藥品或製程液體，因此製造環境的潔淨度需要對應到藥品生產設施的潔淨度等級——否則你在供應商那裡就引入了微粒污染，之後再怎麼控制也難以根除。
blocks.en: The logic behind this is that SUT components directly contact the drug or process fluid, so the cleanliness of the manufacturing environment needs to match the cleanliness grades of drug manufacturing facilities. Otherwise particulate contamination is introduced at the supplier and is difficult to eradicate by any control applied later.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：變更通知是 SUT 最重要的品質控制機制之一
blocks.en: Key Point: Change Notification Is One of the Most Important Quality Controls for SUT

blocks.zh: SUT 供應商的變更通知 (CCN, Customer Change Notification) 在實務中常被低估。一個典型的例子：
blocks.en: The Customer Change Notification (CCN) from SUT suppliers is often underestimated in practice. A typical example:

blocks.zh: 供應商更換了一個組件的薄膜聚合物配方（對他們而言只是「原料優化」）
blocks.en: The supplier changes the film polymer formulation of a component (for them just a "raw material optimization")

blocks.zh: 端用戶的 E&L 萃取/滲出物研究是基於舊配方做的
blocks.en: The end user's E&L (extractables/leachables) study was based on the old formulation

blocks.zh: 新配方可能引入之前未評估過的滲出物
blocks.en: The new formulation may introduce leachables that were never evaluated

blocks.zh: 如果沒有變更通知機制，你根本不會知道這個變更發生了。這就是為什麼品質協議中必須明確要求「所有影響產品的變更，無論大小，都必須事先通知」。
blocks.en: Without a change notification mechanism, you would never know the change happened. That is why the quality agreement must explicitly require that "all changes affecting the product, large or small, must be notified in advance".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：SOP 是供應商的「食譜」
blocks.en: Analogy: The SOP Is the Supplier's "Recipe"

blocks.zh: 想像一家連鎖餐廳——不管哪個城市的分店，同一道菜的味道應該一樣。SUT 供應商的 SOP 就是這個「食譜」。如果同一款一次性薄膜袋在不同生產班別、不同操作員手中做出來的品質都不一樣，那就代表 SOP 不夠詳細或沒有被確實遵守。稽核時，要求查看操作員的實際操作是否符合 SOP，是最直接的品質驗證方式。
blocks.en: Think of a restaurant chain: the same dish should taste the same in every city. The SUT supplier's SOP is that "recipe". If the same single-use film bag varies in quality across production shifts and operators, the SOP is not detailed enough or is not being followed. During an audit, asking to watch operators' actual practice against the SOP is the most direct way to verify quality.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：有效期限的「最短板原則」
blocks.en: Core Concept: The "Weakest Link Principle" for Shelf Life

blocks.zh: 一個完整的一次性組合件 (Assembly) 的有效期限，是由所有組件中有效期限最短的那個決定的（最短板原則）。
blocks.en: The shelf life of a complete single-use assembly is determined by the component with the shortest shelf life (the weakest link principle).

blocks.zh: 這意味著：即使組合件中有 99% 的組件可以放兩年，但如果其中一個接頭的有效期限只有一年，整個組合件就只能用一年。這對倉儲管理有重大影響——採購批量必須根據實際使用速度和最短有效期限的組件來計算，避免大量過期廢棄。
blocks.en: This means that even if 99% of the components in an assembly can be kept for two years, if one connector has a shelf life of only one year, the whole assembly can only be used for one year. This has a major impact on warehouse management: purchase batch sizes must be calculated from actual usage rate and the component with the shortest shelf life, to avoid large quantities expiring and being scrapped.

blocks.zh: 核准材料資料庫的維護在 CDMO 中至關重要：
blocks.en: Maintaining an approved materials database is critical in a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 不同客戶的產品可能有不同的相容性要求
blocks.en: Different clients' products may have different compatibility requirements

blocks.zh: 需要記錄每個組件的核准狀態、核准依據（哪些測試）、有效期限
blocks.en: Record the approval status of each component, the basis for approval (which tests) and the shelf life

blocks.zh: 當供應商發出變更通知時，需要評估哪些客戶產品受影響
blocks.en: When a supplier issues a change notification, assess which client products are affected

blocks.zh: 資料庫應由 QA 部門控管存取權限，避免未經核准的變更
blocks.en: Access to the database should be controlled by QA to prevent unapproved changes

blocks.zh: 你的工廠目前有沒有建立 SUT 供應商的核准材料資料庫？如果沒有，建立這個資料庫最大的挑戰是什麼？
blocks.en: Has your site built an approved materials database for SUT suppliers? If not, what is the biggest challenge in building one?

blocks.zh: 如果供應商通知你一個聚合物配方的微小變更，你的內部評估流程是什麼？誰有決定「需要重新測試」或「可以直接接受」的權限？
blocks.en: If a supplier notifies you of a minor change to a polymer formulation, what is your internal assessment process? Who has the authority to decide "retesting is needed" or "it can be accepted directly"?

blocks.zh: 2.5.3 Defining Supplier Audit Requirements（定義供應商稽核要求）
blocks.en: 2.5.3 Defining Supplier Audit Requirements

blocks.zh: 重點提示：稽核的兩個「殺手問題」
blocks.en: Key Point: Two "Killer Questions" in an Audit

blocks.zh: 在供應商稽核中，有兩個問題的答案最能揭示供應商的品質成熟度：
blocks.en: In a supplier audit, the answers to two questions best reveal the supplier's quality maturity:

blocks.zh: 「請給我看最近三次 CAPA 的關閉記錄。」——好的供應商會有明確的不符合項、根本原因分析和有效的預防措施。品質差的供應商可能沒有 CAPA 記錄（意味著從未認真處理問題），或 CAPA 從未關閉。
blocks.en: "Please show me the closure records of your last three CAPAs." A good supplier will have clear nonconformances, root cause analyses and effective preventive actions. A poor-quality supplier may have no CAPA records (meaning problems were never seriously handled) or CAPAs that were never closed.

blocks.zh: 「你的次供應商 (sub-supplier) 清單在哪裡？他們都有稽核過嗎？」——SUT 的供應鏈很深，原材料供應商（如聚合物樹脂廠商）的品質同樣重要。
blocks.en: "Where is your sub-supplier list? Have they all been audited?" The SUT supply chain is deep, and raw material suppliers (such as polymer resin manufacturers) matter just as much for quality.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：稽核如同駕照更新
blocks.en: Analogy: Audits Are Like Driver's License Renewal

blocks.zh: 稽核就像機動車駕照的定期換照——不是因為你以前出過事故，而是確保「現在的狀態仍然符合標準」。新手司機（新供應商）每年換照，老司機（信譽良好的長期供應商）可以三年一次。但如果你最近有違規記錄（品質事件），就需要立即重新評估，不管距離上次換照多久。
blocks.en: An audit is like the periodic renewal of a driver's license: not because you have had an accident before, but to make sure that "your current status still meets the standard". A new driver (new supplier) renews every year, while an experienced driver (a long-term supplier with a good reputation) may renew every three years. But if you have a recent violation (a quality event), you need to be reassessed immediately, no matter how long ago the last renewal was.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 中，客戶常常會要求查看你的 SUT 供應商稽核記錄，作為盡職調查的一部分。建立一個結構化的供應商稽核程序 (Supplier Audit Program)，包含：
blocks.en: In a CDMO, clients often ask to see your SUT supplier audit records as part of their due diligence. Build a structured Supplier Audit Program that includes:

blocks.zh: 年度稽核計畫（按風險排序）
blocks.en: An annual audit plan (prioritized by risk)

blocks.zh: 標準稽核問卷（覆蓋 ISPE 要求的所有面向）
blocks.en: A standard audit questionnaire (covering all areas required by ISPE)

blocks.zh: 稽核報告模板（含 CAPA 追蹤表）
blocks.en: An audit report template (with a CAPA tracking table)

blocks.zh: 供應商績效評分卡（連結到後續採購決策）
blocks.en: A supplier performance scorecard (linked to later purchasing decisions)

blocks.zh: 這個程序本身也可以成為你競標新客戶時的品質能力展示重點。
blocks.en: This program itself can also be a highlight of your quality capability when bidding for new clients.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：稽核頻率的風險分層
blocks.en: Core Concept: Risk Tiering of Audit Frequency

blocks.zh: ISPE 提供了一個清晰的稽核頻率框架：
blocks.en: ISPE provides a clear framework for audit frequency:

blocks.zh: 注意：SUT 供應商通常被歸類為「高關鍵性」，因此每年稽核是業界通常的做法。
blocks.en: Note: SUT suppliers are usually classified as "high criticality", so an annual audit is the common industry practice.

blocks.zh: 2.6 User Requirement Specification Development（使用者需求規格的制定）
blocks.en: 2.6 User Requirement Specification Development

blocks.zh: 核心概念：URS 的三層結構
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three-Layer Structure of a URS

blocks.zh: ISPE 建議 URS 包含三類要求：
blocks.en: ISPE recommends that a URS include three types of requirements:

blocks.zh: 產品品質要求：E&L 萃取物/滲出物、生物相容性、微粒、完整性（來自 2.4 節）
blocks.en: Product quality requirements: E&L (extractables/leachables), biocompatibility, particulates, integrity (from Section 2.4)

blocks.zh: 供應商品質要求：製造環境、稽核、變更管控（來自 2.5 節）
blocks.en: Supplier quality requirements: manufacturing environment, audits, change control (from Section 2.5)

blocks.zh: 製程技術要求：流量、壓力、溫度、尺寸、接頭類型（由端用戶自行定義）
blocks.en: Process technical requirements: flow rate, pressure, temperature, dimensions, connector types (defined by the end user)

blocks.zh: URS 是由端用戶撰寫，傳遞給供應商的文件——不是供應商的規格書，是你告訴供應商「我需要什麼」的文件。
blocks.en: The URS is a document written by the end user and passed to the supplier. It is not the supplier's specification; it is the document in which you tell the supplier "what I need".

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：URS vs. FRS vs. DS
blocks.en: Key Terms: URS vs. FRS vs. DS

blocks.zh: 在 C&Q（委託與確效）體系中，文件層次通常是：
blocks.en: In the C&Q (commissioning and qualification) system, the document hierarchy is usually:

blocks.zh: URS（使用者需求規格）：我需要什麼功能（業主/使用者視角）
blocks.en: URS (User Requirements Specification): what functions I need (the owner/user perspective)

blocks.zh: FRS（功能需求規格）：系統如何實現這些功能（工程師視角）
blocks.en: FRS (Functional Requirements Specification): how the system delivers those functions (the engineer's perspective)

blocks.zh: DS（設計規格）：詳細的技術設計（製造商/供應商視角）
blocks.en: DS (Design Specification): the detailed technical design (the manufacturer/supplier perspective)

blocks.zh: SUT 的 URS 對應的是 C&Q 體系的最頂層——它是所有後續確效活動的依據，因此必須完整、準確。
blocks.en: The SUT URS sits at the very top of the C&Q system. It is the basis for all later qualification activities, so it must be complete and accurate.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：保密與技術揭露的平衡
blocks.en: Key Point: Balancing Confidentiality and Technical Disclosure

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：在制定 URS 時，有時需要向供應商揭露敏感的製程信息，才能確保一次性組件的設計符合你的需求。例如，你需要告訴供應商你的緩衝液 pH 值範圍，供應商才能選擇合適的聚合物材料。
blocks.en: ISPE states clearly that when developing the URS, it is sometimes necessary to disclose sensitive process information to the supplier so that the single-use component design meets your needs. For example, you need to tell the supplier your buffer pH range so that the supplier can select a suitable polymer material.

blocks.zh: 解決方案：在 URS 發出前，先簽署保密協議 (NDA, Non-Disclosure Agreement)。這既保護了你的智慧財產，又讓供應商能夠提出最合適的技術方案。
blocks.en: Solution: sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before the URS is issued. This protects your intellectual property while allowing the supplier to propose the most suitable technical solution.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：URS 就是你的「裝修需求書」
blocks.en: Analogy: The URS Is Your "Renovation Brief"

blocks.zh: 想像你請承包商幫你裝修廚房。好的「裝修需求書（URS）」應該說：「我需要一個能容納 6 人用餐的中島（功能要求）、所有接縫必須防水（品質要求）、所有材料必須通過食品安全認證（法規要求）」。而不應該說：「請幫我用某某品牌的石英石做中島」——那已經是設計規格了，過早限制了供應商提出創新解法的空間。
blocks.en: Imagine hiring a contractor to renovate your kitchen. A good renovation brief (URS) should say: "I need an island that seats 6 people (functional requirement), all joints must be waterproof (quality requirement), and all materials must pass food safety certification (regulatory requirement)." It should not say: "Please build the island using brand X quartz". That is already a design specification and limits too early the supplier's room to propose innovative solutions.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 中，制定 SUT 的 URS 時有一個特殊挑戰：這個 URS 是你（CDMO）制定的，但最終使用者是你的客戶。最佳做法是：
blocks.en: In a CDMO, developing a SUT URS has a particular challenge: the URS is written by you (the CDMO), but the final user is your client. The best practice is to:

blocks.zh: 建立一個標準 URS 模板，覆蓋所有 ISPE 要求的要素
blocks.en: Build a standard URS template that covers all elements required by ISPE

blocks.zh: 與客戶的技術和 QA 團隊共同審核 URS，確保客戶的特殊要求（如特定的 E&L 規格）被納入
blocks.en: Review the URS jointly with the client's technical and QA teams to make sure the client's special requirements (such as specific E&L specifications) are included

blocks.zh: 在 URS 上獲取客戶的簽署核准，確立責任歸屬
blocks.en: Obtain the client's signed approval on the URS to establish accountability

blocks.zh: 2.6.2 Additional Considerations for SU Components, Assemblies, and Systems（組件、組合件與系統的 URS 差異）
blocks.en: 2.6.2 Additional Considerations for SU Components, Assemblies, and Systems

blocks.zh: 重點提示：為什麼要附上組合件草圖？
blocks.en: Key Point: Why Attach an Assembly Sketch?

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別強調在 URS 中附上組合件草圖 (Assembly Sketch)。原因是：
blocks.en: ISPE specifically stresses attaching an Assembly Sketch to the URS. The reasons:

blocks.zh: 文字描述容易產生歧義（例如「三通接頭」——方向是哪個方向？）
blocks.en: Text descriptions are prone to ambiguity (for example, for a "tee connector", which direction is which?)

blocks.zh: 草圖可以明確確認接頭位置、流向、感測器位置
blocks.en: A sketch can clearly confirm connector positions, flow direction and sensor positions

blocks.zh: 供應商可以用草圖作為設計基礎，減少返工
blocks.en: The supplier can use the sketch as the basis for design, reducing rework

blocks.zh: 草圖成為後續確效的「設計基準文件」
blocks.en: The sketch becomes the "design baseline document" for later qualification

blocks.zh: 你的工廠目前在採購一次性組件時，是否有書面的 URS？如果沒有，最常發生的問題是什麼（如：產品不符合使用條件、與現有設備不相容）？
blocks.en: When your site buys single-use components, do you have a written URS? If not, what problems occur most often (for example, the product does not meet conditions of use, or is incompatible with existing equipment)?

blocks.zh: 如果你需要為一台一次性生物反應器（包含生物反應器袋 + 不銹鋼支撐架 + 控制系統）制定 URS，你會如何組織這份文件？需要哪些部門參與？
blocks.en: If you needed to write a URS for a single-use bioreactor (bioreactor bag + stainless steel support + control system), how would you organize the document? Which departments would need to be involved?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：URS 複雜度的三個層次
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Levels of URS Complexity

blocks.zh: 理解 SUT 的 URS 複雜度層次有助於合理分配文件制定的工作量：
blocks.en: Understanding the levels of URS complexity for SUT helps allocate the effort of document development sensibly:

blocks.zh: SUS 的 URS 需要整合 ISPE C&Q、GAMP 5 等多個指引，因為它同時包含一次性耗材和需要確效的設備。
blocks.en: The URS for an SUS (single-use system) must integrate multiple guides such as ISPE C&Q and GAMP 5, because it contains both single-use consumables and equipment that must be qualified.

blocks.zh: 2.7 Facility Design（設施設計）
blocks.en: 2.7 Facility Design

blocks.zh: 重點提示：細胞療法設施的特殊性
blocks.en: Key Point: The Special Case of Cell Therapy Facilities

blocks.zh: 細胞與基因療法設施幾乎完全依賴 SUT 的原因是：傳統不銹鋼設備的清洗驗證對於高度客製化、小批量的個人化醫療產品根本不切實際。每個批次可能對應不同的患者，不可能在批次之間做完整的清潔驗證。因此，一次性耗材在細胞療法中是一種法規必要性，不只是便利選項。
blocks.en: Cell and gene therapy facilities rely almost entirely on SUT because cleaning validation of conventional stainless steel equipment is simply impractical for highly customized, small-batch personalized medicines. Each batch may correspond to a different patient, so full cleaning validation between batches is not possible. Single-use consumables in cell therapy are therefore a regulatory necessity, not just a convenience.

blocks.zh: 對於無菌充填 CDMO，SUT 的主要應用在充填線的儲液桶和轉液管路。評估是否引入 SUT 時，需要重點考量：
blocks.en: For a sterile fill-finish CDMO, the main SUT applications are the holding tanks and transfer lines on the filling line. When evaluating whether to introduce SUT, the key considerations are:

blocks.zh: 現有倉儲空間是否足夠存放大量一次性耗材？
blocks.en: Is there enough warehouse space to store large quantities of single-use consumables?

blocks.zh: 廢棄物暫存和處理路線是否已規劃（考量 GMP 流向）？
blocks.en: Have waste staging and disposal routes been planned (considering GMP flow)?

blocks.zh: 充填線旁邊是否有足夠的暫存區放置待使用的組合件？
blocks.en: Is there enough staging space next to the filling line for assemblies waiting to be used?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUT 對設施設計的雙向影響
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Two-Way Impact of SUT on Facility Design

blocks.zh: SUT 導入後，設施空間需求出現了有趣的「此消彼長」現象：
blocks.en: After SUT is introduced, facility space requirements show an interesting trade-off:

blocks.zh: 這個「空間再分配」效應，在設計新廠或改建舊廠時必須提前規劃。
blocks.en: This "space reallocation" effect must be planned in advance when designing a new plant or retrofitting an old one.

blocks.zh: 2.7.1.1–2.7.1.3 Facility Design Concepts（設施設計概念）
blocks.en: 2.7.1.1–2.7.1.3 Facility Design Concepts

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：舞廳 vs. 舞池
blocks.en: Analogy: Ballroom vs. Dance Floor

blocks.zh: 舞廳概念就像辦公室的「開放式辦公」——理論上很靈活，每個人可以隨意換位置。但實際上，大家電腦的網路線、電源線都插在固定位置，「隨時可移動」成了幻想。
blocks.en: The ballroom concept is like an "open-plan office": in theory it is flexible and anyone can move anywhere. In reality, everyone's network and power cables are plugged into fixed positions, so "can be moved at any time" becomes an illusion.

blocks.zh: 舞池概念就像精心設計的「工作站島嶼」——每個工作站的位置是固定的，但線路都走天花板，走廊保持暢通，人員不會被線絆倒。這需要更多前期設計，但使用起來更安全、更高效。
blocks.en: The dance floor concept is like a carefully designed "island of workstations": the position of each workstation is fixed, but the cabling runs through the ceiling, the aisles stay clear and nobody trips over cables. It takes more up-front design but is safer and more efficient in use.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：18 個月 vs. 5 年的意義
blocks.en: Key Point: What 18 Months vs. 5 Years Means

blocks.zh: 箱中工廠 (Factory-in-a-Box) 能將設施投入運營的時間從傳統的 3-5 年縮短到 18 個月，這對製藥行業的意義是：
blocks.en: A Factory-in-a-Box can shorten the time to bring a facility into operation from the traditional 3-5 years to 18 months. For the pharmaceutical industry this means:

blocks.zh: 更快回應市場：特別是緊急疫情應對（如 COVID-19 疫苗生產）
blocks.en: Faster response to the market: especially in emergency pandemic response (such as COVID-19 vaccine production)

blocks.zh: 降低資本風險：18 個月後才能看到資本回報，而不是等 5 年
blocks.en: Lower capital risk: capital returns can be seen after 18 months rather than waiting 5 years

blocks.zh: 更容易擴展：標準模組可以在現有廠區的不同位置複製
blocks.en: Easier expansion: standard modules can be replicated at different locations on an existing site

blocks.zh: 這也是為什麼 GE（現在的 Cytiva）等公司大力推廣模組化 SUT 設施解決方案。
blocks.en: This is also why companies such as GE (now Cytiva) strongly promote modular SUT facility solutions.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠現有佈局最接近哪個概念（舞廳式、舞池式、或其他）？你遇過哪些因佈局設計不當導致的操作問題（如管路絆倒、物料流向混亂）？
blocks.en: Which concept is your site's current layout closest to (ballroom, dance floor or something else)? What operational problems have you met because of poor layout design (such as tripping over lines or confused material flow)?

blocks.zh: 如果你的公司要新建一座無菌充填 CDMO 廠，你會選擇哪種設施設計概念？原因是什麼？
blocks.en: If your company were building a new sterile fill-finish CDMO plant, which facility design concept would you choose? Why?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三種設施設計哲學的比較
blocks.en: Core Concept: Comparing the Three Facility Design Philosophies

blocks.zh: ISPE 介紹的三種設施設計概念，反映了 SUT 設施設計思維的演進：
blocks.en: The three facility design concepts introduced by ISPE reflect the evolution of thinking in SUT facility design:

blocks.zh: 2.7.2 Bioprocess Area Applications（生物製程區域應用）
blocks.en: 2.7.2 Bioprocess Area Applications

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUT 在生物製程各階段的滲透率
blocks.en: Core Concept: SUT Penetration Across Bioprocess Stages

blocks.zh: SUT 在生物製程各個階段的採用程度是不均等的：
blocks.en: The adoption of SUT is uneven across the stages of bioprocessing:

blocks.zh: 上游 (Upstream)：SUT 採用率最高，因為批量通常較小（<3000L），SUT 技術已成熟
blocks.en: Upstream: the highest SUT adoption, because batch sizes are usually small (<3000 L) and SUT technology is mature

blocks.zh: 下游 (Downstream)：採用率中等，柱層析仍多為不銹鋼，但緩衝液暫存容器和轉液管路廣泛使用 SUT
blocks.en: Downstream: moderate adoption. Chromatography columns are still mostly stainless steel, but buffer hold vessels and transfer lines widely use SUT

blocks.zh: 充填灌裝 (Fill/Finish)：採用率正在快速增加，特別是中間儲槽已普遍改為一次性袋子
blocks.en: Fill/Finish: adoption is increasing rapidly, especially as intermediate holding tanks have commonly changed to single-use bags

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「80 cm 柱徑」的判斷規則
blocks.en: Key Point: The "80 cm Column Diameter" Rule of Thumb

blocks.zh: ISPE 提供了一個實用的決策規則：如果層析柱直徑超過 80 cm，通常需要不銹鋼緩衝液儲槽。這個規則的背後邏輯是：大直徑柱需要大量緩衝液，而大體積（>2000L）的一次性容器目前在技術上和成本上都不具優勢。
blocks.en: ISPE gives a practical decision rule: if the chromatography column diameter exceeds 80 cm, stainless steel buffer tanks are usually needed. The logic is that large-diameter columns need large volumes of buffer, and large single-use containers (>2000 L) currently have no advantage in either technology or cost.

blocks.zh: 但這個規則會隨著連續層析技術 (Continuous Chromatography) 的普及而改變——連續層析大幅降低了緩衝液的需求量，讓更大規模的 SUT 應用成為可能。
blocks.en: But this rule will change as Continuous Chromatography becomes widespread. Continuous chromatography greatly reduces buffer demand and makes larger-scale SUT applications possible.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：充填線的 SUT 革命
blocks.en: Analogy: The SUT Revolution on the Filling Line

blocks.zh: 傳統充填線的中間儲槽就像餐廳廚房的大湯鍋——每次換菜色都要徹底清洗，需要大量人力和驗證工作。SUT 的一次性儲液袋就像使用免洗鍋——用完直接換掉，省掉清洗驗證的麻煩。「負重傳感器掛架 (Load Cell Hanger Frame)」就是讓你可以把一次性袋子掛在原本放不銹鋼儲槽位置的掛具，讓你在既有充填線上快速引入 SUT。
blocks.en: The intermediate holding tank on a traditional filling line is like the big soup pot in a restaurant kitchen: every change of menu requires a thorough wash, with a lot of labor and validation work. A SUT single-use bag is like using a disposable pot: after use you simply replace it and save the trouble of cleaning validation. A "Load Cell Hanger Frame" is the fixture that lets you hang a single-use bag where a stainless steel tank used to stand, so you can introduce SUT quickly on an existing filling line.

blocks.zh: 對於無菌充填 CDMO 而言，最直接的 SUT 應用機會是：
blocks.en: For a sterile fill-finish CDMO, the most direct SUT opportunities are:

blocks.zh: 充填線的中間儲液容器改為一次性袋子（搭配負重傳感器掛架）
blocks.en: Change the intermediate holding vessel on the filling line to a single-use bag (with a load cell hanger frame)

blocks.zh: 原液從生產端轉移至充填線的轉液管組改為一次性管路
blocks.en: Change the transfer line set that moves bulk product from production to the filling line to single-use tubing

blocks.zh: 這兩項改變可以顯著減少交叉污染風險（對 CDMO 尤其重要，因為同一設備服務多個客戶）
blocks.en: These two changes can significantly reduce the risk of cross-contamination (especially important for a CDMO, because the same equipment serves multiple clients)

blocks.zh: 同時減少 CIP 驗證工作量，提高設備利用率
blocks.en: They also reduce the CIP validation workload and raise equipment utilization

blocks.zh: 2.7.3 Key Considerations, Challenges, and Potential Advantages（關鍵考量、挑戰與潛在優勢）
blocks.en: 2.7.3 Key Considerations, Challenges, and Potential Advantages

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUT 規模門檻——何時停止使用 SUT？
blocks.en: Core Concept: The SUT Scale Threshold: When to Stop Using SUT?

blocks.zh: SUT 並非在所有規模下都比不銹鋼經濟。有一個「成本交叉點」：
blocks.en: SUT is not more economical than stainless steel at every scale. There is a "cost crossover point":

blocks.zh: 當容器體積超過 2000 L 時，一次性袋子的物理裝卸和流體管路限制開始成為問題
blocks.en: When container volume exceeds 2000 L, the physical handling of single-use bags and fluid line limitations start to become a problem

blocks.zh: 按「每克藥品成本」計算，不銹鋼系統在大規模時更具優勢
blocks.en: On a "cost per gram of drug" basis, stainless steel systems have the advantage at large scale

blocks.zh: 這個交叉點會隨著連續製程技術成熟而逐漸上移（未來可能 5000L 以上才需要不銹鋼）
blocks.en: This crossover point will gradually move up as continuous processing matures (in future, stainless steel may only be needed above 5000 L)

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，了解這個門檻有助於為不同規模的客戶提供最合適的技術建議。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, knowing this threshold helps give clients of different scales the most suitable technical advice.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：多樓層設計的液壓陷阱
blocks.en: Key Point: The Hydraulic Trap of Multi-Floor Design

blocks.zh: 這是一個容易被忽略但很重要的工程細節。當一次性袋子在一樓，液體需要通過管路輸送到地下室或二樓的設備時：
blocks.en: This is an easily overlooked but important engineering detail. When a single-use bag is on the first floor and liquid must be piped to equipment in the basement or on the second floor:

blocks.zh: 10 米高度差 = 約 0.981 bar 的靜液壓 (Head Pressure)
blocks.en: A 10 m height difference = about 0.981 bar of static head pressure

blocks.zh: 這可能超過標準一次性管路的額定壓力
blocks.en: This may exceed the rated pressure of standard single-use tubing

blocks.zh: 需要選用高壓等級管路，增加成本
blocks.en: High pressure rated tubing is needed, which increases cost

blocks.zh: 或重新規劃佈局，讓物料流向「順重力」
blocks.en: Or the layout must be re-planned so that material flows "with gravity"

blocks.zh: 這個問題在不銹鋼系統中不存在（管路設計為高壓承受），但在 SUT 中必須作為設施設計的考量因素。
blocks.en: This problem does not exist in stainless steel systems (the piping is designed to withstand high pressure), but in SUT it must be a factor in facility design.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：雙走廊 vs. 單走廊 GMP 流向
blocks.en: Analogy: Double-Corridor vs. Single-Corridor GMP Flow

blocks.zh: 雙走廊就像機場的入境和出境完全分開——進來的人（乾淨側）和離開的人（使用後側）走不同的通道，不會交叉。最嚴格，但空間需求大。
blocks.en: A double corridor is like an airport where arrivals and departures are completely separate: people coming in (clean side) and leaving (used side) take different routes and never cross. It is the strictest option but needs a lot of space.

blocks.zh: 單走廊就像大多數辦公室——進出用同一條走廊，依靠 SOP 管理時序來避免衝突。空間效率高，但需要嚴格的操作紀律。對於 BSL 設施，雙走廊通常是必要的。
blocks.en: A single corridor is like most offices: entry and exit use the same corridor, and SOPs manage the timing to avoid conflicts. It is space-efficient but needs strict operating discipline. For BSL facilities, a double corridor is usually required.

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填 CDMO，GMP 流向設計尤為重要，因為廢棄的一次性耗材（使用後帶有產品污染）必須與乾淨的新耗材完全分開。常見的最佳做法：
blocks.en: In a sterile fill-finish CDMO, GMP flow design is especially important, because used single-use consumables (contaminated with product after use) must be kept completely separate from clean new consumables. Common best practices:

blocks.zh: 廢棄物使用專用廢棄物走廊或電梯離開生產區
blocks.en: Waste leaves the production area through a dedicated waste corridor or elevator

blocks.zh: 使用後的一次性袋子立即放入密封廢棄物容器，不在潔淨區開封
blocks.en: Used single-use bags go straight into sealed waste containers and are not opened in the cleanroom

blocks.zh: 廢棄物出口與原料入口保持最大分離距離
blocks.en: Keep the waste exit as far as possible from the raw material entrance

blocks.zh: 2.7.4–2.7.5 Storage, Supply, and Safety Considerations（儲存、供給與安全考量）
blocks.en: 2.7.4–2.7.5 Storage, Supply, and Safety Considerations

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUT 的倉儲挑戰
blocks.en: Core Concept: Warehousing Challenges of SUT

blocks.zh: SUT 導入後，倉儲管理比想像中複雜：
blocks.en: After SUT is introduced, warehouse management is more complex than expected:

blocks.zh: 前置時間長：一次性組合件的前置時間 (Lead Time) 通常是 8-16 週，需要較大的安全庫存
blocks.en: Long lead time: the lead time for single-use assemblies is usually 8-16 weeks, requiring a larger safety stock

blocks.zh: 體積龐大：即使折疊狀態，一次性袋子的外包裝也佔用大量空間
blocks.en: Bulky: even folded, the outer packaging of single-use bags takes up a lot of space

blocks.zh: 廢棄物體積是新品的 3-5 倍：使用後膨脹的廢棄物比壓縮的新品佔用更多空間
blocks.en: Waste volume is 3-5 times that of new product: expanded used waste takes up more space than compressed new product

blocks.zh: 廢棄物拾取頻率決定暫存空間：若廢棄物公司每兩週來一次，你需要兩週的廢棄物暫存空間
blocks.en: Waste pickup frequency determines staging space: if the waste contractor comes every two weeks, you need two weeks of waste staging space

blocks.zh: 重點提示：SUT 的獨特安全風險
blocks.en: Key Point: Unique Safety Risks of SUT

blocks.zh: 與不銹鋼系統相比，SUT 帶來了一些新的安全風險，需要特別的設施設計和操作 SOP：
blocks.en: Compared with stainless steel systems, SUT brings some new safety risks that call for specific facility design and operating SOPs:

blocks.zh: 地面管路絆倒風險：一次性管路在地面拉伸，比不銹鋼管道更容易造成絆倒
blocks.en: Trip hazard from floor lines: single-use tubing stretched across the floor is more likely to cause tripping than stainless steel piping

blocks.zh: 眼部噴濺風險：透明的生物反應器袋在眼睛高度，操作員需要護目鏡
blocks.en: Eye splash risk: transparent bioreactor bags are at eye level, so operators need eye protection

blocks.zh: 凍結袋子的割傷風險：冷凍儲存的一次性袋子硬而脆，解凍時操作不當可能造成洩漏
blocks.en: Cut risk from frozen bags: single-use bags in frozen storage are hard and brittle, and improper handling during thawing may cause leaks

blocks.zh: 連接脫離的氣溶膠風險：在斷開連接時可能有氣溶膠產生，特別是高生物安全級別設施要特別注意
blocks.en: Aerosol risk on disconnection: aerosols may be generated when connections are disconnected, which needs special attention in high biosafety level facilities

blocks.zh: 你的工廠有沒有評估過一次性耗材的廢棄物體積？一個充填批次大約產生多少體積的 SUT 廢棄物？你目前的廢棄物暫存空間夠用嗎？
blocks.en: Has your site assessed the waste volume of single-use consumables? Roughly how much SUT waste does one filling batch generate? Is your current waste staging space sufficient?

blocks.zh: 在安裝一次性生物反應器袋時，操作員最常遇到的安全問題是什麼？現有的 SOP 和安全設施是否足夠應對這些風險？
blocks.en: When installing a single-use bioreactor bag, what safety problems do operators meet most often? Are the existing SOPs and safety provisions adequate to deal with these risks?

blocks.zh: 2.8 Waste Management（廢棄物管理）
blocks.en: 2.8 Waste Management

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：去污 vs. 滅菌
blocks.en: Key Terms: Decontamination vs. Sterilization

blocks.zh: 去污 (Decontamination)：使廢棄物「安全到可以丟棄」的過程——目的是降低生物危害風險，而不一定是達到滅菌等級。
blocks.en: Decontamination: the process of making waste "safe enough to discard". The aim is to reduce biohazard risk, not necessarily to reach a sterilization level.

blocks.zh: 滅菌 (Sterilization)：消滅所有微生物（包括孢子）的過程——更嚴格的處理。
blocks.en: Sterilization: the process of destroying all microorganisms (including spores), a more stringent treatment.

blocks.zh: 在廢棄物管理中，通常要求「去污」而非「滅菌」——但兩者在實務中常用相同的方法（高壓蒸汽），主要差異在於驗證要求和記錄要求的嚴格程度。
blocks.en: In waste management, "decontamination" rather than "sterilization" is usually required, but the two often use the same method in practice (autoclaving). The main difference is the rigor of validation and record requirements.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：高壓蒸汽滅菌 vs. 焚化
blocks.en: Analogy: Autoclave vs. Incineration

blocks.zh: 高壓蒸汽滅菌 (Autoclave)就像用高溫高壓的電鍋「殺菌」——把細菌和病毒消滅，讓廢棄物安全到可以丟進一般廢棄物處理流程（或焚化爐）。
blocks.en: An autoclave is like a high-temperature, high-pressure rice cooker used to "kill germs": bacteria and viruses are destroyed, making the waste safe enough to enter the general waste stream (or the incinerator).

blocks.zh: 焚化 (Incineration)就像用火把廢棄物「完全消滅」——不只殺菌，連廢棄物的物理形態也消失了，只剩下灰燼。焚化可以回收能源（發電），對高效能化合物（如抗癌藥物殘留）尤其有效，因為高溫可以破壞分子結構。
blocks.en: Incineration is like using fire to "completely eliminate" waste: it not only kills germs but also removes the physical form of the waste, leaving only ash. Incineration can recover energy (power generation) and is especially effective for highly potent compounds (such as anticancer drug residues), because high temperature destroys the molecular structure.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：SUT 廢棄物是一次性技術最大的環境批評點
blocks.en: Key Point: SUT Waste Is the Biggest Environmental Criticism of Single-Use Technology

blocks.zh: SUT 面臨的最主要環境挑戰是：大量塑膠廢棄物。一個中等規模的生物藥廠每年可產生數十噸一次性塑膠廢棄物。目前業界的回應策略包括：
blocks.en: The main environmental challenge facing SUT is the large volume of plastic waste. A mid-sized biopharma plant can generate tens of tonnes of single-use plastic waste every year. Current industry response strategies include:

blocks.zh: 廢棄物最小化設計：選擇組件更少的組合件設計
blocks.en: Waste-minimizing design: choose assembly designs with fewer components

blocks.zh: 能源回收焚化：將焚化熱能轉化為廠區供電或供熱，減少淨碳排放
blocks.en: Energy-recovery incineration: convert incineration heat into site electricity or heating, reducing net carbon emissions

blocks.zh: 去污後回收：部分沒有生物污染的廢棄物，在適當去污後可以進入塑膠回收流程
blocks.en: Recycling after decontamination: some waste with no biological contamination can enter plastic recycling streams after appropriate decontamination

blocks.zh: 生物可降解材料研發：業界正在研究生物可降解聚合物作為替代材料（仍在早期階段）
blocks.en: Biodegradable material development: the industry is researching biodegradable polymers as alternative materials (still at an early stage)

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填 CDMO 中，SUT 廢棄物管理需要考慮的特殊情境：
blocks.en: Special situations that SUT waste management must consider in a sterile fill-finish CDMO:

blocks.zh: 多產品交叉污染風險：不同客戶產品的 SUT 廢棄物必須分開標記和處理，避免交叉識別錯誤
blocks.en: Cross-contamination risk across products: SUT waste from different clients' products must be labeled and handled separately to avoid cross-identification errors

blocks.zh: 高效能化合物：如果客戶產品含有高效能化合物（oncology），所有接觸過產品的 SUT 廢棄物都需要特殊處理路徑，並產生相應的廢棄物處理記錄
blocks.en: Highly potent compounds: if a client's product contains highly potent compounds (oncology), all SUT waste that has contacted the product needs a special handling route, with corresponding waste disposal records

blocks.zh: 廢棄物成本計入服務合約：SUT 廢棄物的高壓蒸汽滅菌和焚化成本不低，在與客戶協商服務合約時應將這部分成本明確計入
blocks.en: Waste cost included in the service contract: the autoclave and incineration costs of SUT waste are not small, and should be explicitly included when negotiating service contracts with clients

blocks.zh: 環境法規合規：台灣的廢棄物處理法規要求所有生物危害廢棄物必須委託合法的廢棄物處理業者，並保留廢棄物轉移聯單
blocks.en: Environmental regulatory compliance: Taiwan's waste regulations require all biohazardous waste to be entrusted to a licensed waste disposal contractor, with waste transfer manifests retained

blocks.zh: 你的工廠目前如何處理 SUT 廢棄物？是先高壓蒸汽滅菌再焚化，還是直接委外焚化？選擇這個流程的依據是什麼（法規要求、成本、效率）？
blocks.en: How does your site currently handle SUT waste? Is it autoclaved first and then incinerated, or sent directly for outsourced incineration? What is the basis for choosing this process (regulatory requirements, cost, efficiency)?

blocks.zh: 如果你的客戶要求你提交 SUT 廢棄物的環境影響報告，你目前能提供哪些數據？缺少哪些追蹤記錄？
blocks.en: If a client asked you to submit an environmental impact report on SUT waste, what data could you provide today? Which tracking records are missing?

blocks.zh: 在計算 SUT 總體擁有成本 (Total Cost of Ownership) 時，廢棄物處理成本通常佔多少百分比？這個比例在你的工廠中如何？
blocks.en: When calculating the Total Cost of Ownership of SUT, what percentage does waste disposal cost usually account for? How does this ratio look at your site?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：廢棄物類型決定處理方式
blocks.en: Core Concept: Waste Type Determines Treatment Method

blocks.zh: SUT 廢棄物的處理方式取決於廢棄物的性質：
blocks.en: The treatment method for SUT waste depends on the nature of the waste:

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 供應商品質協議 (Quality Agreement) 是 SUT 供應鏈管理的基礎文件，必須與供應協議和技術協議獨立分開，確保 QA 部門的主導地位。協議中必須明確包含稽核權利、變更通知義務和責任分工。
blocks.en: The Quality Agreement is the foundation document of SUT supply chain management and must be kept separate from the supply agreement and the technical agreement, so that QA keeps the lead. The agreement must explicitly include audit rights, change notification obligations and the division of responsibilities.

blocks.zh: SUT 供應商製造環境等級：一般組件製造需 ISO 8/Grade C，最終組合作業需 ISO 7/Grade B——這是因為 SUT 直接接觸藥品，其製造潔淨度等級必須與藥品生產環境對齊。
blocks.en: SUT supplier manufacturing environment grades: general component manufacture requires ISO 8/Grade C and final assembly operations require ISO 7/Grade B. This is because SUT directly contacts the drug, so its manufacturing cleanliness grade must align with the drug manufacturing environment.

blocks.zh: 供應商稽核頻率的風險分層：新供應商或高關鍵物料每年稽核，有良好記錄的長期合作夥伴每 2-3 年稽核一次。SUT 供應商通常被歸為高關鍵性，因此每年稽核是慣例。
blocks.en: Risk tiering of supplier audit frequency: new suppliers or high-criticality materials are audited annually, and long-term partners with a good record every 2-3 years. SUT suppliers are usually classified as high criticality, so an annual audit is the norm.

blocks.zh: URS 的三層結構：產品品質要求 + 供應商品質要求 + 製程技術要求。URS 由端用戶（你）撰寫，傳遞給供應商。建議附上組合件草圖。對 SUS（包含設備的整合系統），URS 複雜度顯著提升，需整合 C&Q 和 GAMP 5 框架。
blocks.en: The three-layer structure of the URS: product quality requirements + supplier quality requirements + process technical requirements. The URS is written by the end user (you) and passed to the supplier. Attaching an assembly sketch is recommended. For an SUS (an integrated system that includes equipment), URS complexity rises significantly and the C&Q and GAMP 5 frameworks need to be integrated.

blocks.zh: 設施設計的演進：舞廳式（靈活但混亂）→ 舞池式（緊湊安全，需前期設計投入）。箱中工廠（模組化，18 個月交付）和箱中箱（利用既有建築外殼）提供了加速新廠建設的選項。SUT 導入後，倉儲和廢棄物空間顯著增加，清洗/公用設施空間縮小。
blocks.en: Evolution of facility design: ballroom style (flexible but chaotic) → dance floor style (compact and safe, needs up-front design effort). Factory-in-a-Box (modular, 18-month delivery) and Box-within-a-Box (using the shell of an existing building) offer options for accelerating new plant construction. After SUT is introduced, warehouse and waste space increases significantly while cleaning/utility space shrinks.

blocks.zh: 廢棄物管理雙軌制：一般廢棄物 → 垃圾掩埋；生物危害廢棄物 → 高壓蒸汽滅菌去污 + 焚化。高效能化合物廢棄物需要授權廢棄物處理商。廢棄物管理成本和空間需求必須在 SUT 設施設計初期就納入規劃。
blocks.en: The dual-track approach to waste management: general waste → landfill; biohazardous waste → autoclave decontamination + incineration. Highly potent compound waste requires an authorized waste contractor. The cost and space requirements of waste management must be built into planning at the very start of SUT facility design.
